name: Dead Bug
instructions: On your back, arms up, knees at 90°. Slowly extend opposite arm and leg toward the floor without letting your low back lift. Return and switch sides.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your torso. Hold briefly, return, then switch sides. Keep hips square.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: On hands and knees, alternate between arching your back upward (cat) and letting it sag downward (cow) slowly with the breath.

name: Hip Flexor Lunge Stretch
instructions: Lunge forward and drop the back knee to the floor. Push hips forward gently to feel the stretch through the front of the hip. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Standing Thoracic Rotation
instructions: Stand tall with hands behind your head. Rotate the upper body as far as comfortable each direction, keeping the hips facing forward.

name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel and sit back on your heels, stretch arms forward on the floor, relax your forehead down. Breathe deeply into your back.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
instructions: Lie on your back, drop both knees to one side while keeping shoulders on the floor. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Legs-Up-the-Wall
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall, swing your legs up so they rest against it, and lie back. Stay still and breathe slowly.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Back flat against a wall, knees at 90 degrees. Hold the position without letting hips drop.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: High plank, drive knees to chest alternately as fast as possible. Keep hips level and core engaged the whole time.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop to a squat, kick feet back to plank, do a push-up, jump feet to hands, then explode upward with arms overhead.

name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place driving knees up to hip height, pumping arms in rhythm. Stay on the balls of your feet throughout.

name: Pike Push-up
instructions: Form an inverted V with hips high. Bend elbows to lower your head toward the floor, then press back up. Targets the shoulders.

name: Scapular Wall Slide
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall, elbows and wrists touching it. Slide arms up and down while keeping contact and ribs down.

name: Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down with arms in a Y. Lift arms a few inches off the floor by squeezing the mid-back, then lower with control.

name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down, lift chest, arms, and legs a few inches off the floor. Hold without cranking the neck.

name: Reverse Snow Angel
instructions: Lie face down with arms at your sides. Sweep them out and overhead along the floor, then reverse. Keep thumbs up and neck long.

name: Glute Bridge Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive hips up and hold at the top, squeezing glutes without arching the low back.

name: Dumbbell Farmer Carry
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Walk tall with ribs down and shoulders packed. Set the bells down under control.

name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your side. Walk without leaning toward or away from the weight. Switch hands each set.

name: Banded Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a light band at chest height with arms straight. Pull the band apart until it touches your chest, then return slowly.

name: Banded External Rotation
instructions: Elbow pinned to your side at 90°. Rotate the forearm outward against a light band, then return slowly. Switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Hold
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, elbows tucked. Stand tall and breathe into your belly without letting the ribs flare.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on a bench or the floor holding one dumbbell over your chest. Lower it behind your head with a slight elbow bend, then pull it back over.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope at face height. Pull toward your face, leading with the elbows, and externally rotate at the end. Control the return.

name: Cable Pallof Press
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable at chest height. Press the handle straight out and resist rotation. Hold briefly, then return. Switch sides.

name: Trap Bar Farmer Carry
instructions: Stand inside a loaded trap bar, pick it up with a tall torso, and walk with short even steps. Set it down under control.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Extension
instructions: Face away from a high cable with a rope. Extend the elbows overhead without flaring the ribs, then return with control.
